verdict.rationale: Zep scopes memory per User (with per-user Context Graphs, thread association) and supports ABAC/RBAC policies limiting which agents/MCP users can access which context, plus per-user deletion for isolation (RTBF). This directly supports tenant isolation across users/agents/apps. missing for 10: no explicit independent/hands-on test confirming no cross-tenant leakage, and no detailed doc on application-level (multi-app) scoping beyond user/agent boundaries.
